newsitem.title: USA: Clinton reads Christmas poem to children.
newsitem.headline: Clinton reads Christmas poem to children.

text.p: President Clinton took time out of his schedule Friday to read a traditional Christmas poem to children amid festive holiday decorations in the White House East Room.

Seated on a bench with his wife Hillary and surrounded by a group of 5- to 10-year-old children from area schools, Clinton revelled in his annual duty of reading the poem about jolly old St. Nick, "T'was the Night Before Christmas."
One wide-eyed little boy told the president after the reading: "I saw you on TV." Clinton laughed and said: "I'd be in big trouble if you never saw me on TV."
As much as the children were excited at being with the Clintons, they were even more delighted when the Clintons' cat, Socks, was brought in for some petting.
